description: This Java source file defines the class VmTracesParser, which parses VM trace information from Android bug reports, specifically focusing on processing lines from a log and extracting process snapshots to build VmTraces objects.

classes.name: VmTracesParser
classes.description: A parser class for extracting VM traces from Java Lines of log entries, particularly focusing on process snapshots within Android bug report logs.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a collection of lines from a bug report log, extracting process snapshots and compiling them into a VmTraces object.
